description: Reconstructed Meteor-M N2-3 LRPT transmitting antenna pattern in an idealised satellite body frame. Gain in dBic: the unknown receiver calibration cancels, so the absolute scale is transferred from the supplied M2-4 reference pattern (Ku_dB). Accuracy is bounded by uncertainty_sources.

uncertainty_sources.source: Unequal transmit power at the antenna terminals
uncertainty_sources.description: The transfer assumes both satellites deliver the same power to their antennas (6.5 W each, including spacecraft feed/cable losses).
uncertainty_sources.effect_on_m2_3: Constant offset of the whole pattern, dB for dB; the shape is unaffected.
uncertainty_sources.current_handling: PT_M2_3_W = 6.5 W, PT_M2_4_W = 6.5 W -> correction +0.00 dB.
uncertainty_sources.estimate_from_this_data: Not observable: indistinguishable from a constant gain offset.
uncertainty_sources.how_to_reduce: Put measured or telemetry transmitter output powers into PT_M2_3_W / PT_M2_4_W.

uncertainty_sources.source: Different receive processing for the two signals
uncertainty_sources.description: The receiver constant C must be identical for both satellites. The power estimator used different frequency offsets (M2-3 2180 Hz, M2-4 2980 Hz) through an uneven passband, so the fraction of signal power captured can differ between the satellites.
uncertainty_sources.effect_on_m2_3: Constant offset of the whole pattern; a Doppler-dependent passband loss would also add forward/aft structure.
uncertainty_sources.estimate_from_this_data: M2-4 hold-out residual forward 0.181 dB vs aft 0.323 dB: no Doppler-dependent loss above ~0.5 dB for M2-4. The constant part is not observable.
uncertainty_sources.how_to_reduce: Measure the passband response at both frequency offsets and correct the captured power fraction per satellite.

uncertainty_sources.source: Definition and shape of the M2-4 reference pattern
uncertainty_sources.description: Whether Ku_dB is realised gain or directivity, dBi or dBic, and whether its off-boresight shape is correct. Outputs are labelled dBic (GAIN_UNIT).
uncertainty_sources.effect_on_m2_3: A unit/definition error is a constant offset. An error in the reference's theta-shape transfers 1:1 into M2-3's off-nadir dependence, because it is degenerate with the receiver's elevation response.
uncertainty_sources.estimate_from_this_data: Not observable from these passes; the closure test checks only self-consistency.
uncertainty_sources.how_to_reduce: Confirm the reference's provenance (measured or simulated, gain or directivity, polarisation).

uncertainty_sources.source: In-flight M2-4 differs from the axisymmetric, nadir-pointing reference
uncertainty_sources.description: Attitude offsets, antenna tilt or polarisation effects make the real M2-4 pattern depend on body azimuth.
uncertainty_sources.effect_on_m2_3: Local, direction-dependent error: at each ground-station direction the receiver map absorbs M2-4's deviation averaged over the passes that saw that direction and passes it into M2-3 with the opposite sign.
uncertainty_sources.estimate_from_this_data: M2-4 hold-out residual by body quadrant (off-nadir >= 20 deg): {'forward_315_45': 0.181, 'starboard_45_135': 1.932, 'aft_135_225': 0.323, 'port_225_315': -1.295} dB, i.e. roughly +/-1-2 dB locally; overall offset +0.14 dB.
uncertainty_sources.how_to_reduce: find_m24_pattern_uncertainty.ipynb estimates the M2-4 deviation map, propagates it into the M2-3 grid (m2_3_gain_uncertainty.csv) and adds per-cell bootstrap scatter.

outputs.m2_3_antenna_pattern.csv: Regular grid azimuth_deg 0..359 x off_nadir_deg 0..62 (1 deg). gain_dbic: median of recovered per-sample gains at measured nodes (sample_count > 0), gap-limited linear interpolation at empty nodes (sample_count == 0), NaN where unsupported. normalized_gain_db = gain_dbic - max(gain_dbic).
outputs.receiver_response_map.csv/.png: Stage-1 receiver response map R = C + G_r in the ground-station frame.
outputs.rejected_rows_by_file.csv: Rejected input rows per satellite, file and reason.
outputs.input_files.csv: Per-file row counts and time span.
outputs.diagnostics.txt: Human-readable summary of this metadata's diagnostics block.

model.equation: p_ij = C + G_t,ij + G_r,j + L(d_ij);  L(d) = 20 log10(lambda / (4 pi d)), d in metres
model.stage1: R_j = p_4j - G_t4(theta_j) - L(d_4j) = C + G_r,j
model.stage2: G_t3 = p_3j - L(d_3j) - R_hat(az_3j, alt_3j) - 10 log10(PT_M2_3_W / PT_M2_4_W)
notes: power_db is in arbitrary units; the receiver-chain calibration C cancels between the satellites, so no absolute received-power calibration is needed (gain-comparison method with M2-4 as the reference antenna). The M2-3 gain inherits the absolute scale of Ku_dB (dBic).
Receiver antenna is not assumed isotropic: its response is mapped in the ground-station frame.
Polarisation mismatch neglected (both RHCP). Atmospheric/ionospheric losses not modelled.
Non-positive power rows are rejected, never replaced. Median aggregation is applied to recovered gains, not raw power.
Rows with power near the noise floor that were positive by chance are kept; the upstream dfs_filtered step removed rows below -50 dB and scintillation episodes.
The M2-3 pattern is not assumed axisymmetric or nadir-pointing.

conventions.ground_station_frame: az_deg clockwise from geodetic north in [0, 360); alt_deg above the WGS84 ellipsoid-normal horizon; ENU line of sight [cos(alt) sin(az), cos(alt) cos(az), sin(alt)].
conventions.satellite_position: r_sat = r_GS(WGS84 geodetic -> ECEF) + range_m * u_ECEF.
conventions.body_frame: Idealised (not measured attitude). z_b = geocentric nadir -r_sat/|r_sat|; x_b = direction of travel projected perpendicular to z_b; y_b = z_b x x_b (right-handed; starboard).
conventions.body_azimuth: azimuth_deg = atan2(q.y_b, q.x_b) in [0, 360); 0 = direction of travel, 90 = +y_b.
conventions.off_nadir: off_nadir_deg = atan2(sqrt(qx^2+qy^2), qz); 0 = nadir. Not the ground-station elevation.
conventions.nadir_choice: The task's printed nadir formula equals q (satellite->GS) and would give off_nadir = 0 everywhere; the geocentric nadir was used instead, as agreed with the user.
conventions.m2_4_off_boresight: Angle between satellite->GS and geocentric nadir (M2-4 boresight = nadir).
conventions.plot_orientation: Polar plots show the body frame viewed from above the satellite looking toward nadir: 0 deg (forward) at top, azimuth increasing clockwise toward +y_b.
conventions.units: Angles in degrees, distances in metres internally (range_km * 1000), gains in dBic (normalized_gain_db and the receiver response map are relative dB).

geometry_timing.issue: az/alt/range are given once per second at AOS + k s and were attached to 0.1 s power samples by floor(time_s), so geometry lags each sample by 0-0.9 s.
geometry_timing.handling: ECEF position and travel direction linearly interpolated to AOS + time_s between the surrounding per-second positions of the same track (gap <= 10 s); otherwise the supplied geometry is used and the row is counted as fallback_supplied.

heading.method: Per-second unique positions per track; central chord r[i+1]-r[i-1] if both steps <= 10 s, one-sided displacement at track ends or gaps, otherwise the time-nearest valid heading of the same track (borrowed, counted). Rows sharing a timestamp are collapsed first because adjacent raw rows have zero displacement.
heading.note: 'ecef' uses velocity relative to the rotating Earth (as specified); this differs from the inertial orbital velocity direction by ~2-3.5 deg at these latitudes.

rejection_rules.later_exclusions: M2-4: off-boresight outside the reference pattern. M2-3: receiver map unsupported (outside hull or gap > limit); invalid heading; off_nadir rounds above 62 deg.

methods.stage1_interpolation: Stage 1 (receiver map, ground-station frame): samples median-aggregated to the nearest node of a 1-deg (azimuth 0-359, elevation 0-90) grid, evaluated at each M2-3 sample's own az/el; populated nodes are support points of a scipy.spatial.Delaunay triangulation in (azimuth, polar) degrees with azimuth copies at +/-360 deg for nodes within 6 deg of the seam; barycentric linear interpolation; a query is accepted only if the vertices with non-zero barycentric weight span <= 5 deg in azimuth and <= 5 deg in the polar angle; outside the convex hull -> NaN (no extrapolation).
methods.stage3_interpolation: Stage 3 (M2-3 pattern, body frame): samples median-aggregated to the nearest node of a 1-deg (azimuth 0-359, off-nadir 0-62) grid; measured nodes keep their median, empty nodes are interpolated; populated nodes are support points of a scipy.spatial.Delaunay triangulation in (azimuth, polar) degrees with azimuth copies at +/-360 deg for nodes within 6 deg of the seam; barycentric linear interpolation; a query is accepted only if the vertices with non-zero barycentric weight span <= 5 deg in azimuth and <= 5 deg in the polar angle; outside the convex hull -> NaN (no extrapolation).
